description: Election Commission - N. G. N. N. Wijesuriya was elected as the member of the Ambanganga Korale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Ambanganga Korale Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral procedures for local authorities, including the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member's absence. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
